name: Exp_Directed_Movement
summary: This EA trades based on the crossover of the Directed Movement indicator's upper and lower lines, which are derived from a doubly-smoothed RSI. It opens buy positions when the upper line crosses above the lower line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable position closing and money management options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Directed Movement指标的上轨和下轨交叉进行交易，该指标由双重平滑的RSI衍生而来。当上轨上穿下轨时开多仓，反之下穿时开空仓，并提供可配置的平仓和资金管理选项。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于Directed Movement自定义指标的双线交叉信号，本质上是一个双重平滑RSI动量系统。入场条件为：当上轨从下方穿越下轨时产生买入信号，当下轨从上方穿越上轨时产生卖出信号，信号基于SignalBar根K线前的交叉判断。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向信号触发时平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose）。仓位管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的多种模式，支持按自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的自由保证金或余额比例计算手数，也支持固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例（默认0.1），MMMode选择计算模式（默认固定手数LOT）。策略使用了两层平滑处理，第一层默认SMA周期12，第二层默认JJMA周期5，旨在过滤RSI的噪音以产生更稳定的信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on the crossover of the Directed Movement custom indicator's two lines, which is essentially a doubly-smoothed RSI momentum system. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when the upper line crosses above the lower line, and a sell signal is generated when the upper line crosses below the lower line, with signals evaluated at the SignalBar-th bar back. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, as well as closing positions on reverse signals via BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters. Position sizing uses multiple modes from TradeAlgorithms.mqh, supporting lot calculation based on free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin or balance percentages, or fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1) for risk ratio, and MMMode selects the calculation mode (default fixed lot LOT). The strategy applies two layers of smoothing to RSI, with the first layer defaulting to SMA period 12 and the second to JJMA period 5, aiming to filter RSI noise for more stable signals.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter, lots or ratio

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/固定手数等）
parameters.description_en: Margin calculation mode (fixed lots, balance percentage, etc.)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许反向信号平多仓
parameters.description_en: Close long positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许反向信号平空仓
parameters.description_en: Allow closing short positions on signal reversal

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号判断使用的K线索引
parameters.description_en: Signal bar index (0 for current bar)

pros: 双重平滑RSI有效过滤噪音，减少虚假信号
提供多种资金管理模式，灵活性高
止损止盈齐全，风险可控
支持独立控制开仓和平仓方向，策略配置灵活
使用IsNewBar机制避免同根K线内重复交易
pros_en: Doubly-smoothed RSI effectively filters noise and reduces false signals
Multiple money management modes provide high flexibility
Complete stop loss and take profit settings for controllable risk
Independent control of open and close directions allows flexible strategy configuration
IsNewBar mechanism prevents repeated trading within the same bar
cons: 依赖自定义指标Directed_Movement和外部头文件，部署和维护复杂
没有点差过滤，在H4周期虽影响较小但仍有风险
缺乏多空同时持仓的处理逻辑，可能出现对冲冲突
信号仅基于两根K线的交叉，缺乏趋势确认机制
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，对多数品种不合适
cons_en: Depends on custom indicator Directed_Movement and external include files, making deployment and maintenance complex
No spread filter, though less critical on H4 timeframe it still poses risk
Lacks logic for handling simultaneous long and short positions, potential hedging conflicts
Signals based only on two-bar crossover lack trend confirmation mechanism
Default stop loss 1000 and take profit 2000 points are excessive for most instruments
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如大周期MA方向确认），避免震荡行情中频繁开仓
添加点差过滤和最大持仓检查，增强风险控制
将止损止盈参数改为ATR动态计算，适应不同品种波动特性
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., higher timeframe MA direction confirmation) to avoid frequent entries in ranging markets
Add spread filter and maximum position checks for enhanced risk control
Convert stop loss and take profit to ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to different instruments' volatility characteristics

risk_points: 没有点差过滤，高波动时滑点可能显著
缺乏最大持仓数量限制，极端情况下可能过度开仓
固定点数止损止盈不适应所有品种的波动特性
risk_points_en: No spread filter, slippage can be significant during high volatility
No maximum position count limit, potential over-exposure in extreme conditions
Fixed point stop loss/take profit doesn't adapt to all instruments' volatility characteristics
